verdict: Leads are coming in — but tracking is broken and being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns recorded 16 conversions on $1,687.76 in spend, and your CRM logged 49 new opportunities — so demand is real. Your lead count shows zero because the connection between ad activity and CRM tracking is severed; that is a reporting gap, not a gap in actual interest, and it is being repaired. Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply over the last three days of the period, which is being monitored as a possible sign of late-summer demand softening ahead of the heating season. Going into September, LSA heating campaigns are scheduled to switch on and the Homer Glen branch page goes live — both of which expand your reach at the right time of year.

highlights.phrase: new opportunities recorded in your CRM this period
calls generated from your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
total ad spend this period, all through Google Ads

watch_item.issue: CRM lead tracking is showing zero despite confirmed opportunity and conversion activity — the data connection is broken, not the demand.
watch_item.fix: Attribution between your ads and CRM is being repaired so next week's report reflects actual lead volume accurately.
